title: RIFF: Add a basic RIFF dissector
description:
The WebP format uses the RIFF container, so it sees some use these
days in addition to older formats like WAV and AVI. Add generic parsing
of chunks, though no actual chunk types yet.

notes.body: Why did you create this non-const variable when some of the fields it moves past are fixed-length?
Really just habit, but yes, in this case that would always be 4 and it could be a constant or a define. The only variable lengths (aside from the chunk lengths) would be in different functions.
